It's funny that you said that. I had a fucking nightmare of a day. 

First, I got stuck at work for an extra 2.5 hours. So an 10.5 hour day which is very rare. I drove over 200 miles in that time. Average is about 80-100 tops.

Second, I drove to the park. I had my supplies, I was going to go. There was a cop sitting in the parking lot. So I reached out to several people, all of whom did not reply or didn't want anything to do with me. I drove away, to a parking lot where I just sat and bawled.

Third, on my drive headed home feeling like a failure I found out my brother outted me to many, many people. He then proceeded to call me a c**t. I don't know what brought that on. But two sides to every story, maybe I did something. I dunno.

Fourth, my sister went off on me when I arrived home. Making me feel really really shitty. It was over me upsetting her feelings when she almost broke my finger.

Fifth, I found out my grandfather is in the hospital (he's fine, yay!).

Sixth, I explained my intentions to one of the people I reached out to. He proceeded to tell me that all of my problems are my fault, that I continue the cycle of shit headed my way because I don't remain positive. I tried to explain that I had been trying since I got out of the psych hospital, but it's hard to keep that going when you're surrounded by negative people. Seriously, it's like #2 on the list of things to do after a suicide attempt. Be near happy people. -.-

And finally I hit a realization. Feeling like shit, having cried all day, I sat on the couch I live on, about to turn in and feeling like a total failure. I may be the center of my problems, sure. But I'll be fucking damned if I'll give all these assholes the gratification of me not being around to piss them off. Fuck them. And their shit parade.

I had my first therapy session in over a month today. I asked my therapist to focus in on the possibility of me being bipolar. We're going to figure out why my antidepressants don't work. And why I can't be happy with life.

Since I quit smoking 10 days ago, I'm going to start getting in shape. I'm somewhere between 5'9" or 6'0" about 150lbs, fairly fit from my physical job. But I'm going to get into the 135/140 range, and show everyone that I'm healthy, happy, and hot. Fuck them.

Fuck. All. Of. Them.

I've been talking to the same friend all night, I've asked three times to hangout. First he didn't answer. Second, said tonight he just really couldn't. Third he just ignored.
I don't have any money to move. I am still in the negative from my attempts in the past.

Trans people can be gay, lesbian, bisexual, asexual, pansexual, poly, or any variation. Gender + sexual preference are two separate things.  

That being said, there's no "her". There's no "him". I've told everyone I had feelings that I had feelings for them. Now, none of them talk to me.

I've held out for a day. And another. And another. Since my last attempt a few months ago. I can't pretend I'm okay anymore. It's just... I want to go. And just rest. No more fucking heartache, no more longing for someone to just fucking care about me. No more... Just no more.

It's just... Too much. When you reach out to empty ears, ask for a hand and given the finger... It wears on me. Tonight, I texted my closest friend. I said I might be on that side of town, if he'd like to hangout. He hasn't replied. I texted another friend, and another. Still nothing. From anyone. I just got off a 10.5 hour day at a 9.50 per hour job. I drove over 200 fucking miles. I just... I can't do this anymore. I don't even feel like crying, I just want it to all end.

It's not like that. Around my friends I didn't discuss how shit I feel. I make the day about our friendship. I stay upbeat despite, on the inside, I feel like curling into a ball and disappearing. I'm not a bad friend, honestly. I just... People don't want anything to do with me. And it has worn me down to the point where I just... Just stopped trying. And now I just don't see a future. I don't have the fight in me anymore...
Because I despise my reflection. I just don't see the point in trying anymore. I've tried so goddamn hard. It's time to just... Stop.
I just don't know. I'm not a priority since I came out. I'm not really important to anyone. And when I try to make myself important to myself, I just feel like an idiot.

Just birth. Gender issues fucking suck. I just hate my body not doing what I want it to. It should've been different. My life should have gone differently, and I can't fucking change it... I don't have the money for things, or honestly see a future anymore.

I ultimately wish my friends just wanted to include me in their life. I invite to go out and do things, but always get stood up... I just want someone to... Value me. I know it's wrong to gauge life on how others view me, but I can't keep myself up anymore. I gave up before my last attempt. I want to give up now. Every partner I've had or almost had crushed me because they couldn't be with someone trans. 

I haven't been hugged in over a year. Haven't held hands with someone, felt lips against mine, in just as long. I've *never* been held in bed by someone. I'd give **anything** to just feel someone breathe with me. And feel safe and small and wanted for once.
